This test build addresses an OpenGL version check during Forge startup. On Better MC [FORGE] BMC4, the early window reported OpenGL 0.0 even though the active Magma renderer reported 4.6. Forge then rejected a mod requiring OpenGL 3.2.

Install the IPA using your usual sideloading method and press **Play** on your existing Better MC profile. The package uses the same patched Magma driver as the gameplay FPS and upscaling build. Reaching the title screen and loading a world still need device verification.
